text:
Marta: Heads up — thinking about adding small routing/quota + telemetry annotations to saved views. Idea: saved views carry a lightweight "hints" section with sampling, preferred route, and quota estimate. Wanted reactions before I spin up an API PR.
Jordan: ++ need this for rollout gating. If a saved view can say 'sample_rate: 5%' we can auto-apply higher-fidelity telemetry during experiments without manual toggles.
Matt: UX thought — compact badge on saved view card: 'Q:5% | S:10k' or 'route: r196'. Click -> preview implications modal. Keep main list uncluttered.
Lee: API note — we'd need to extend the savedquery schema. Two approaches: embed metadata in existing object or have a separate viewHints resource. I lean separate to avoid breaking clients.
Simone: Telemetry caveat — sample rate is not monolithic. Traces vs token-level vs eval sampling all differ. We need clear keying.
Marta: Good point. Proposal (simple): keys: routing_hint (route_id), quota_est (tokens_per_min), telemetry_sample:{type:rate}. Example: ```{
  "routing_hint":"route-196",
  "quota_est":"1200tpm",
  "telemetry_sample":{ "trace":"1%", "eval":"10%" }
}```
Lee: Implementation nit — our persisted schema prefers flat columns. Nested telemetry_sample will mean special parsing. I suggest flattened keys like telemetry_trace_sample and telemetry_eval_sample.
Jordan: For rollouts we also want an optional fallback_route policy so saved views can define an ordered routing preference when capacity is constrained.
Matt: Also worth showing a quick cost-estimate on hover computed from model profile + quota_est so product teams can see currency impact before they push.
Marta: Open question: permissioning. Who can add routing_hint? Org admins only? Team owners? This could become a way to steer traffic.
Simone: Policy: only view owners + org admins can set routing_hint. Others can save copies but hints are stripped unless they have rights.
Lee: API contract draft: PATCH /savedviews/:id with body keys under view_hints.*. We'll implement migration and feature-flag it.
Marta: I'll write an RFC with UI mocks + API sketch. TL;DR: saved views get optional hints for routing/quota/telemetry; UI badges + preview; separate hints endpoint; RBAC control.
Jordan: Sounds good. Can we gate behind flag feature.saved_view_hints so we can dogfood?
ops-bot: feature flag created: feature.saved_view_hints for org=redwood-beta
Matt: :thumbsup:
Simone: One more — telemetry sampling overrides must emit audit logs with who/when/which-view so we can tie experiments to data quality changes.
Lee: Noted — will add audit entries on hint mutations.
Marta: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link once it's up. Short-term action: Jordan + Lee sync on API/console mockups tomorrow.
Jordan: I'll pick this up tomorrow morning, adding API sketch to the RFC.
